newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedish shares end lower on European trends.
newsitem.headline: Swedish shares end lower on European trends.

text.p: Swedish shares shrugged off a higher Wall Street open on Wednesday to fall with other European stockmarkets as higher bond yields added to the gloomy mood.
The Stockholm bourse's general index fell 1.35 percent to 2,491.69 in turnover of 4.28 billion crowns.
Telecoms group Ericsson dropped 7.5 crowns to 233 as it was dragged down by the bearish market and after a Stockholm brokerage's negative report on the company.
Forestry group Stora fell two crowns to 93.5 after releasing lower than expected 1996 earnings while the forestry sector index closed down 1.5 percent.
The banking sector index fell 1.56 percent.
Yet another Swedish magazine quoted sources as saying a merger between Nordbanken and S-E-Banken was looming, this one saying it would be announced in the middle of this week.
Drug company Astra closed down three crowns to 337.

"The fact that Astra fell after the strong Losec figures presented on Tuesday shows how weak the market is," one broker said. A day earlier the company said sales of its blockbusting anti-ulcer drug Losec in the U.S. rose 40 percent in 1996.
Profit-taking hit clothing retailer Hennes & Mauritz after the share jumped 75 crowns on Tuesday. The share closed down 24 crowns to 1,091 ahead of its 1996 due on Thursday afternoon.
